per_candidate.id: s2:2D BAO vs. 3D BAO: Solving the Hubble Tension with Bimetric Cosmology

rationale: Paper 2309.03263 investigates the impact of metallicity on Cepheid photometry, which is relevant to the question of systematics in distance measurements. Paper 2311.08253 reviews the impact of dust on Cepheid and Type Ia Supernova distances, addressing another potential source of systematic error. Both contribute evidence on parts of the question, but do not fully resolve it.
